originalSpec.name: FORGE LAB
originalSpec.visualGoal: Make it feel like a real engineering workbench where one active artifact is being assembled, tested, inspected, and prepared for handoff—not a monitoring dashboard.

topLeft.name: MISSION CLAMP
topLeft.purpose: Pinned Work Card, requested result, source refs, constraints; readable at a glance but visually secondary.

topRight.name: BUILD RECIPE
topRight.purpose: Current plan / intended change / must-keep / must-not-change / target result.

center.name: FORGE BENCH
center.purpose: Large active working surface showing the current artifact/module, diff/assembly layers, selected component, and direct manipulations.

leftRail.name: MATERIAL RACK
leftRail.purpose: Files, modules, branches, dependencies, reusable components; drag or select into the bench.

rightRail.name: TEST BAY
rightRail.purpose: Functional checks, integration checks, permission boundary, recovery, unknowns; PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN shown with evidence.

bottom.name: EVIDENCE TRACK
bottom.purpose: Builds/versions V1 V2 V3, hashes, test receipts, snapshots, rollback points; current version obvious.

handoff.name: FACTORY DOCK
handoff.purpose: A single deliberate exit from Forge Lab to Factory when evidence is ready; never visually mixed with editing controls.

interactionModel: One Work Card owns the bench.
One primary artifact is in focus at a time.
Selecting a material shows where it came from and what it changes.
Every test result has evidence or remains UNKNOWN.
Factory handoff is a separate deliberate action, not an accidental button.

style.mood: precision workshop / compact forge / engineering lab
style.shapes: physical worktable metaphor, trays, clamps, racks, dock
style.typography: clean technical labels with large human-readable status
style.colorBehavior: neutral workspace; reserve strong color for state/evidence only

states.EMPTY: Bench clear, Mission Clamp waiting for Work Card.
states.ACTIVE: Artifact centered; recipe and selected materials visible.
states.TESTING: Test Bay becomes visually active while bench remains readable.
states.BLOCKED: The exact blocker is pinned beside the artifact; unrelated panels dim.
states.READY_FOR_FACTORY: Factory Dock lights up only after evidence/unknown rules are satisfied.
